tool_summary: Installs, upgrades, and removes Ruby packages (gems). Native extension gems run arbitrary extconf.rb/Rakefile build code at install time.
platform_notes: gem behavior and flags are consistent across Linux and macOS.

rules.description: The --source flag points gem at a source other than the default RubyGems.org. Installing from an untrusted or unfamiliar source is a common supply-chain attack vector, since native extension gems execute build code at install time with the invoking user's privileges.
rules.reversible_note: The gem can be uninstalled, but its install-time build scripts may have already made changes beyond the gem's own files.

rules.description: Installs a gem, which downloads it and can execute arbitrary native extension build code (extconf.rb) with the invoking user's privileges.
rules.reversible_note: The gem can be uninstalled, but install-time build scripts may have already made changes beyond the gem's own files.

rules.description: Manages Ruby gems. Read-only subcommands (list, search, info) do not alter system state. Severity here reflects that unrecognized or future gem subcommands fall through to this rule; known read-only subcommands are not themselves being flagged as risky.
rules.notes: Default bumped to WARNING (not INFO) because this tool's CLI surface evolves quickly; an unmatched/unrecognized subcommand should surface for review rather than silently pass as benign.
